Using **grill**.

## Context

New auth service — choosing where session data lives before any code. Nothing is in production yet.

---

## Questions

### 1. Where should session data live in v1?

- **A)** Redis (recommended)
- **B)** In-process memory only

> **Recommended: A** — shared across instances without inventing a new store later

Falsifier: if logout must work across every running instance, keeping sessions only in one process’s memory fails after deploy.
